verdict: No open verified findings in the reviewed drawing/engine boundaries. Finite coverage and code-path restrictions below apply.
scope: Independent source review of renderer-only smooth math, shared waypoint/camera boundaries, real retained-frame engine/RNG comparison, and parent actual-Canvas trace instrumentation. Physics/providers/clock remain exact; tiny rendering math differences are explicitly authorized.

fixedFindings.problem: Broad smooth fpTrig changed persistent waypoint F64 Y coordinates by one ULP, causing four ordered next-frame engine trace mismatches in two started profiles while RNG remained equal.
fixedFindings.fix: Both dependency routes disable smoothGraphics throughout waypoint respawn without mutating caller options or invoking unrelated/provider getters.
fixedFindings.evidence: 21-frame comparison now passes with real rendering differences still present.

fixedFindings.problem: Unboxing a Float80 subclass before smooth eligibility incorrectly allowed it to use Math.sin/cos, despite the helper explicitly declining subclass operands.
fixedFindings.fix: Try smooth eligibility on the original operand before unboxing; unsupported operands use the unchanged exact fallback.
fixedFindings.evidence: Independent source delta review plus parent10focused helper/projection tests including class/provider fallback.

realRenderDifferential.scope: Real exact and smooth renderers; exact ordered engine byte read/write traces, phase-labelled RNG calls, sounds and host consumption. Declared native GetPixel answers, not Canvas raster feedback.

End-paint RNG/time/dt/speed/fullmode is compared. The417 prefixes are frames4..420; initialization paints have no advanceFrame.

limits: This is finite scenario coverage; it does not prove arbitrary custom venues, provider objects, mouse positions and control combinations.
The native-fixture differential uses declared native GetPixel answers; the separate default420paint Canvas comparison supplies real raster feedback.
Low-level exported recovered functions are not an advertised smooth API; exact shared-state gating occurs at the real scene dependency boundaries.
No approximate sqrt, skipped drawing/RNG calls, physics provider changes, simulation time changes or2002 smooth mode is introduced.
